concerns.text: Task T012 (ClawSweBenchLoader) is marked as incomplete (checkbox empty) but is a hard prerequisite for T016 (Baseline Execution), T023 (High-Fidelity Execution), and T027 (7B Execution). The plan implies T012 must complete before any experiment runs, yet the task list allows T016/T023/T027 to be attempted without T012 being checked off. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' dependency rule.

Tasks T016, T023, and T027 (Experiment Runners) depend on the filtered dataset produced by T012. Currently, T012 is unchecked while T016/T023/T027 are also unchecked. The ordering must enforce that T012 is completed and verified before T016/T023/T027 can be initiated. The current list does not visually enforce this blocking dependency.

Task T029 (GLM Analysis) depends on T028 (Merge Results), which in turn depends on T016, T023, and T027. Since T016/T023/T027 depend on T012 (Loader), and T012 is currently incomplete, T029 is effectively blocked. The task list should explicitly mark T029 as 'Blocked' or visually indicate the chain of dependency starting from the incomplete T012.

Tasks T040 (RepresentativenessValidator) and T041 (ConstructValidityAudit) are listed as dependencies for T016 (Baseline Execution). However, T040 and T041 are marked as [P] (parallel) and appear in Phase 2, while T016 is in Phase 3. The ordering implies T040/T041 must complete before T016 starts. If T040/T041 are not completed, T016 cannot proceed. The current list does not clearly enforce this blocking sequence.

The task description for T012 includes a note '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_c55fed54 — status=not_enough_info]'. This indicates the task definition itself is incomplete or ambiguous regarding the N=2048 truncation rule. An incomplete task definition cannot be a valid producer for downstream consumers (T016, T023, T027). This should be resolved before the task is considered 'ready' for the dependency chain.
